Plot posterior parameter comparisons across synthesis models

Source: R/compare_models.R
plot_model_comparison.Rd

Creates a faceted density plot comparing the posterior distributions of key parameters (`prev_cf`, `prev_diag`, `lambda`, `shape`, `sens[1]`, `spec[1]`) across synthesis strategies.

Usage

plot_model_comparison(
  comparison_obj,
  variables = c("prev_cf", "prev_diag", "lambda", "shape"),
  truth = NULL
)

Arguments

comparison_obj

An `"evidsynth_comparison"` object returned by [compare_evidsynth()].

variables

Character vector of parameter names to display. Default is `c("prev_cf", "prev_diag", "lambda", "shape")`.

truth

Optional named numeric vector or list of true parameter values (e.g. `c(prev_cf = 0.3, prev_diag = 0.3, lambda = 0.1, shape = 0.1)`) to overlay as vertical dashed reference lines.

Value

A `ggplot2` object.
